engagement.note: Imatinib cut BCR-ABL colonies from patients 92–98% and spared normal ones.
53 of 54 patients had complete hematologic responses at ≥300 mg/day.

dose.note: Trough at 350 mg exceeded the cellular IC50, but ≥400 mg came from clinical white-cell response.
dose.reason: Dose set clinically, not from the model

efficacy.note: Cells driven by the human fusion oncogene.
IRIS confirmed cytogenetic response; the mutagenesis screen recovered all major patient resistance mutations.
Patients whose mutations had high cellular IC50 to nilotinib (Y253H, E255K/V, F359C/V) reached no complete cytogenetic response, as the cells predicted.
efficacy.short: Cells predicted which patients would not respond
efficacy.reason: Also predicted which patients would fail
